CalculatedInsight.description: Top 50 scorers per season. Powers the leaderboard query.
CalculatedInsight.label: Top Scorer By Season
CalculatedInsight.sqlExpression: SELECT season__c, UnifiedPlayer__dlm.unified_player_id__c AS unified_player_id__c, UnifiedPlayer__dlm.player_name__c AS player_name__c, team__c, goals__c, xg_total__c, shots__c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season__c ORDER BY goals__c DESC) AS rank__c FROM PlayerSeasonStats__dll JOIN UnifiedPlayer__dlm ON UnifiedPlayer__dlm.source_player_name__c = PlayerSeasonStats__dll.player__c QUALIFY rank__c <= 50
